Notify.MissingImage: The image could not be loaded: {src}

Gallery.Title: Vista portraits: {name}
Gallery.HintSwitch: Click a portrait to show it in the Vistas.
Gallery.HintUnlinked: This actor's tokens are not linked: a portrait is shown on the tokens you have selected.
Gallery.Label: Name
Gallery.HeightHint: Height of the figure in feet. Empty: the character's portrait height. Lower it for kneeling or crouching poses.
Gallery.MirrorHint: The figure in this image faces the other way than in the character's own portrait.
Gallery.Remove: Remove from the gallery (the file stays)
Gallery.EmptyEdit: No portraits yet. Add single images or import a whole folder.

Gallery.NothingNew: These images are already in the gallery.
Gallery.FolderFailed: The folder {path} could not be read (see the console).

playerSwitch.name: Players switch portraits
playerSwitch.hint: Players may switch the Vista portraits of the characters they own.

playerEdit.name: Players edit galleries
playerEdit.hint: Players may add, rename and remove the portraits of the characters they own.

applyTo.name: A switch changes
applyTo.hint: Which tokens of a character change: in every Vista, or only in the Vista where the switch was made. Unlinked tokens always change alone.
applyTo.all: All Vista tokens of the character
applyTo.scene: Only the tokens in the current Vista

newTokens.name: New tokens keep the portrait
newTokens.hint: A character placed in a Vista starts with the portrait chosen last instead of the actor image.

transition.name: Transition
transition.hint: How the old portrait turns into the new one (Foundry's token transitions).

transitionDuration.name: Transition duration (ms)
transitionDuration.hint: Duration of the transition in milliseconds.

chatNotice.name: Announce in chat
chatNotice.hint: Post a short chat message with the new portrait whenever a character changes its pose.

hudButton.name: Button in the token HUD
hudButton.hint: Show the mask button with the portrait palette when you right-click a token in a Vista.

pose1.name: Portrait 1
pose1.hint: Show the first portrait of the selected token or your character (in a Vista).

poseReset.name: Own portrait
poseReset.hint: Show the character's own portrait (the actor image).

poseNext.name: Next portrait
poseNext.hint: Show the next portrait of the gallery.

posePrevious.name: Previous portrait
posePrevious.hint: Show the previous portrait of the gallery.

toggleLight.name: Light variants on/off
toggleLight.hint: Switch to the light variants of the portraits and back.

openGallery.name: Open the gallery
openGallery.hint: Open the Vista portrait gallery of the selected token or your character.
